description: This file implements the EventThread class and related factory functions for managing event-driven threading, including thread creation, execution, synchronization, and cleanup within the firebolt::rialto::common namespace.

classes.name: IEventThreadFactory
classes.description: Interface for creating event thread factories.

classes.name: EventThreadFactory
classes.description: Concrete implementation of the IEventThreadFactory interface.

classes.name: EventThread
classes.description: Class managing a dedicated thread executing queued functions, with support for thread naming, synchronization, and cleanup.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a new EventThreadFactory instance.

methods.name: createEventThread
methods.description: Creates a new EventThread with the specified thread name.

methods.name: EventThread
methods.description: Constructor initializing the event thread with a given name and starting the thread.

methods.name: ~EventThread
methods.description: Destructor signaling thread shutdown and joining the thread.

methods.name: threadExecutor
methods.description: Main loop executing queued functions, setting thread name, and handling shutdown.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Ensures all queued functions are executed by signaling via semaphore.

methods.name: addImpl
methods.description: Adds a function to the queue for execution by the thread.
